_comment: The form-genres source manifest. Every entry is a REAL public-domain or
openly-licensed source for one output FORM (not Cleo's voice — that is the
separate exemplars.jsonl). fetch.mjs pulls each `url`, slices one-or-more
clean instances of the genre with the named `slicer`, and stamps each
record with this entry's provenance (source, license) plus the retrieval
date. Nothing copyrighted, paywalled, or modern. Obituaries are of the
long dead (pre-1929 newspapers), never living people.
license strings are the BASIS for the public-domain / open claim, recorded
per record so the file is auditable. URLs are the canonical home of each
source; the text we keep is a copy with its papers attached.
search entries (type:search) hit a JSON API and fan out to many results,
so the subject varies and the centroid is a shape, not the memory of one
article. file entries (type:file) fetch one document and slice instances
out of it. Add more entries to widen any genre — more occasions of the
same form, varied subjects, is exactly what a learned shape needs.
